page_title: WOL 1-2 EIN | Wolfsburg v Eintracht Frankfurt 14/09/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+6' Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) controls a poor pass, breaks past an opponent then slices an effort from mid-range well wide of the right post.
90+3' 13:15 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
88' Ralph Hasenhuttl decides to make a substitution. Kilian Fischer will be replaced by Konstantinos Koulierakis (Wolfsburg).
87' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) receives a pass on the edge of the box and attempts a lob as the keeper is off his line, but the effort crashes off the left post.
87' Wolfsburg force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
85' Substitution. Aurele Amenda (Eintracht Frankfurt) on for Hugo Larsson.
82' 1 - 2 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) into the left of the net, giving goalkeeper Kamil Grabara no chance!
82' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.

81' Handball! A player from Wolfsburg handled the ball. The referee gives a penalty to Eintracht Frankfurt after a quick talk with the linesman, who had apparently seen the situation from a better perspective.
80' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Harm Osmers had an easy-decision to make.
80' 4:3 – the corner kicks stats.
77' 1 - 1 Ridle Baku (Wolfsburg) takes a great first touch to control a killer pass on the edge of the box and drills a shot into the bottom right corner in trademark fashion.
74' The attendance for today's match is 20000.
74' It's time for a substitution. Igor Matanovic (Eintracht Frankfurt) comes on in place of Hugo Ekitike.
71' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Mattias Svanberg walks off the pitch to be replaced by Aster Vranckx (Wolfsburg).
71' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Patrick Wimmer as he is replaced by Kevin Behrens (Wolfsburg).
71' Ralph Hasenhuttl has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jonas Wind (Wolfsburg) replacing Tiago Tomas.
68' Eintracht Frankfurt have been awarded a corner kick.
67' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Niels Nkounkou trots off the pitch and is replaced by Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt).

67' A pass into the box finds Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) unmarked. He carefully places a shot towards the bottom right corner, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Kamil Grabara denies him. Eintracht Frankfurt will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
66' Eintracht Frankfurt are seeing far more of the ball now.
64' That was a wasted opportunity to score by Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt). He picks up the rebound and produces a poor effort which is easily saved by the goalkeeper.
63' Ridle Baku (Wolfsburg) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
59' Niels Nkounkou (Eintracht Frankfurt) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
55' Wolfsburg quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
53' Eintracht Frankfurt win a corner.
50' Total attempts – 6:4.
46' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) has tested the patience of referee Harm Osmers and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
46' Half-time substitution. Mario Gotze will not participate anymore and Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) is coming on.
46' Ralph Hasenhuttl makes a half-time substitution. Mohamed Amoura comes on in place of Salih Ozcan (Wolfsburg).
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Kevin Trapp is replaced by Kaua Santos (Eintracht Frankfurt).
46' Harm Osmers blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+3' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+1' Kevin Trapp (Eintracht Frankfurt) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.

43' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) leaps high near the penalty spot and gets a header in from the free kick. It's on target, but the goalkeeper makes a comfortable save to deny the effort. It was a difficult header and it's always tough to put the ball inside the net from positions like that.
41' Mario Gotze (Eintracht Frankfurt) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Harm Osmers signals.
38' Eintracht Frankfurt keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
34' Niels Nkounkou (Eintracht Frankfurt) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
30' 0 - 1 Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) receives the ball inside the box, reacts quickly and without any problems fires the ball into the back of the net.
27' Corner kicks – 3:0.
25' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Ellyes Skhiri (Eintracht Frankfurt) was quite harsh and Harm Osmers didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
24' Robin Koch (Eintracht Frankfurt) performs a sliding tackle but catches his opponent's legs. The referee blows his whistle for an infringement.
21' Harm Osmers interrupts the game. One of the players from Eintracht Frankfurt won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
17' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Eintracht Frankfurt was in an offside position.
15' The possession of the ball – 67:33.
12' Wolfsburg can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
9' The corner from Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) is cleared away by the defence.
9' Ridle Baku (Wolfsburg) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
7' There's an opportunity for Jakub Kaminski (Wolfsburg) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
3' Wolfsburg string together a series of short passes.
1' The match has just started.
Wolfsburg will kick the game off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Harm Osmers.
